QuestInfo.name: Enjoying the Wait 2
QuestInfo.0: It's hard to believe, but this is another world called Maple World. Speak with #bGrendel the Really Old#k for details.
QuestInfo.1: You have the eggs, but now you need firewood. Just think of it as training! Defeat the Axe Stump and collect #b15 pieces of Firewood#k.\r\n\r\nGo to #bWhere the Sun Rises#k and #bWhere the Forest Sings#k.
QuestInfo.2: You have the #b15 pieces of Firewood#k, but #bGrendel the Really Old#k is STILL not here. Speak to Three Moon again.

npc.0: Once you've gathered everything, show Three Moon.
